entities.name: PMID:27504985
observations: Female Sprague-Dawley rats received clinically relevant olanzapine-depot exposure for 8 weeks, with assessments on days 8, 15, 29, 43, and 57.
The study examined time-dependent adipose endocrine and metabolic effects of depot olanzapine.

entities.name: Olanzapine depot
observations: Depot olanzapine produced a biphasic, time-dependent serum leptin response in female rats.
Serum leptin was highly elevated early; increased adiposity appeared later, indicating the endocrine change was not merely attributable to established late fat expansion.

entities.name: Biphasic leptin response
observations: In female rats, olanzapine depot caused an early marked serum leptin elevation followed by a biphasic time-dependent pattern across days 8-57.
Serum ghrelin, FGF-21, IL-1alpha, IL-6, and TNF-alpha did not change at sampled time points; adiponectin, resistin, and visfatin were not established by the available record.
